name: Titz (Germany)
description: Hanging banner divided vertically blue and yellow, charged in the upper half with the municipal arms of Titz (a black lion with stars and a moon on yellow).
history: The banner is blue and yellow striped lengthwise 1:1 with the municipal arms in the upper half; the stars stand for the number of former municipalities, while the meaning of the moon is unexplained.

features.role: Titz arms — lion with stars and moon on yellow
